\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Unique polynomial interpolation]
\lean{TCSlib.Interpolation.exists_unique_degreeLT_eval_eq}
\proofsource{Sha79}{pdf-a76120fbec44-p002-b002}
\proofsource{AL17}{
  pdf-27f2b3787521-p030-b002,
  pdf-27f2b3787521-p030-b003
}
\label{TCSlib.Interpolation.exists_unique_degreeLT_eval_eq}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type with a finite subset $s$, let $v:\iota\to F$
be injective on $s$, and let $w:\iota\to F$. There is a unique polynomial $p\in F[X]$ of
degree less than $|s|$ such that $p(v(i))=w(i)$ for every $i\in s$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Polynomials with prescribed evaluations]
\lean{TCSlib.Interpolation.fixedEvalEquiv}
\statementsource{Vad12}{
  pdf-bf2ce5422088-p075-b004,
  pdf-bf2ce5422088-p075-b005,
  pdf-bf2ce5422088-p075-b006
}
\statementsource{Sha79}{
  pdf-a76120fbec44-p002-b002,
  pdf-a76120fbec44-p002-b004
}
\statementsource{BGW88}{pdf-b3f55f2a4332-p003-b006}
\statementsource{AL17}{
  pdf-27f2b3787521-p032-b002,
  pdf-27f2b3787521-p032-b003,
  pdf-27f2b3787521-p032-b004
}
\label{TCSlib.Interpolation.fixedEvalEquiv}
\leanok
Let $F$ be a field, let $s,t$ be finite sets of indices, and let $v,w$ assign elements
of $F$ to each index. Suppose $v$ is injective on $s$ and $t\subseteq s$. Then the
polynomials over $F$ of degree less than $|s|$ whose values at $v(i)$ equal $w(i)$ for
every $i\in t$ are in bijection with the functions from $s\setminus t$ to $F$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial interpolation on a subset]
\lean{TCSlib.Interpolation.surjective_eval_of_subset}
\proofsource{AL17}{pdf-27f2b3787521-p030-b002}
\label{TCSlib.Interpolation.surjective_eval_of_subset}
\leanok
\proofstep
  {TCSlib.Interpolation.fixedEvalEquiv}
  {context}
  {AL17}
  {pdf-27f2b3787521-p004-b002,
    pdf-27f2b3787521-p030-b002}
\uses{TCSlib.Interpolation.fixedEvalEquiv}
\difficulty{3}
Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type, and let $v:\iota\to F$ be injective on a
finite set $s\subseteq\iota$. For every finite set $t\subseteq s$ and every function
$w:\iota\to F$, there is a polynomial $p\in F[X]$ of degree less than $|s|$ such that
$p(v(i))=w(i)$ for every $i\in t$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Count of partially interpolated polynomials]
\lean{TCSlib.Interpolation.natCard_degreeLT_eval_eq}
\proofsource{Sha79}{pdf-a76120fbec44-p002-b004}
\label{TCSlib.Interpolation.natCard_degreeLT_eval_eq}
\leanok
\proofstep
  {TCSlib.Interpolation.fixedEvalEquiv}
  {context}
  {Sha79}
  {pdf-a76120fbec44-p002-b002,
    pdf-a76120fbec44-p002-b003}
\uses{TCSlib.Interpolation.fixedEvalEquiv}
\difficulty{3}
Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ have finite subsets $t\subseteq s$, let $v:\iota\to F$
be injective on $s$, and let $w:\iota\to F$. The number of polynomials $p\in F[X]$ of
degree less than $|s|$ satisfying $p(v(i))=w(i)$ for every $i\in t$ is $|F|^{|s|-|t|}$.
\end{theorem}
